Root cause: The tax-inclusive discounted line total was computed as `self.line_price_incl_tax - incl_tax_discounts` with no lower bound. When a discount (e.g. an absolute-amount offer) exceeds the line price, this returns a negative number, which then flows into Basket.total_incl_tax and into order line prices via the basket totals.
